name: Lazy Fish 83
author: Wasim-Rana
description: Gradient 3d rounded dark violet button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, transform becomes rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) rotateZ(0deg), box-shadow becomes 0px 4px 5px #5d2b82,
    0px 7px 8px #4d1e7491,
    0px 13px 18px #4d1e7450,
    0px 20px 40px #4d1e74a8, background changes from linear-gradient(180deg, #d28dff, #8533c6) to linear-gradient(180deg, #c17de6, #7328b8).
